Third Experiment The overall set of results are shown in Tables 13, 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18. It can be seen that the MEMM model played a significant role in achieving the higher recognition rates in the first experiment. When it is replaced with HMM, the system is unable to display the same high per- formance under the exact same settings. Thus this experiment validates our hypothesis and provides clear evidence that MEMM based recognition model has the capability to accurately classify expressions in both spontaneous and natural environments.
